Which of the following best describes the fallacy of equivocation?
Option A: A form of loaded language that uses an emotionally charged restatement of the claim in place of support for the claim.
Option B: Changing the meaning of a word or phrase from one part of the argument to another.
Option C: Confusing figurative language with literal language.
Option D: Referring to an act committed by an opponent in negative terms while referring to the same act committed by the arguer or supporters in favorable terms.
